context_requirements: Expression of one or more 5-HT receptors (HTR1/2/3/6/7) or DRD2 on the cell line
Intact Gq/Gi-coupled signaling and downstream MAPK/ERK or cAMP-PKA pathways
For antiproliferative/apoptotic effects, dependence on Akt/mTOR and protein translation pathways
For hepatocyte effects, intact 5-HT-mediated regeneration signaling
falsifiers: No consistent transcriptional response across any of the nine cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Absence of immediate-early gene induction (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h in responsive lines
No change in proliferation or apoptosis markers at 24 h despite receptor expression
Responses that are equally strong in lines lacking 5-HT receptor expression as in receptor-positive lines

evidence.supports: 5-HT1A agonist/5-HT2A antagonist flibanserin alters retinal gene expression and is neuroprotective in vivo
5-HT receptor agonist quipazine promotes proliferation and apoptosis in human hepatocyte L-02 cells
5-HT1B/1D agonist 5-nonyloxytryptamine and analogues induce apoptosis and inhibit Akt/mTOR signaling in breast cancer cells

changes: Removed MYC from late_down because it already appears in proximal_down; a gene cannot be in both an up and a down list of the same time.
Removed CCND1 from late_down because it already appears in proximal_down; a gene cannot be in both an up and a down list of the same time.
